subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Akademiya to meet up with Alhaitham

30220202.text: Ugh, not really... Paimon got too nervous thinking about today and didn't fall asleep until the sun was almost up...

30220204.text: Naturally, I slept just fine. After all, a good rest should be considered part of the plan, since energy is an important resource.

30220205.text: Y—You just wanna show off how calm you are!

30220206.text: It's crucial to dissipate any tension before we execute our plan.

30220207.text: The only thing you're doing is being annoying!

30220208.text: Anyway, do you need me to go over the game plan again?

30220211.text: Our target is Grand Sage Azar's office. Everyone in the Akademiya knows that's where the Grand Sage's console is. Only they can operate it.

30220212.text: Many restricted commands and operations are executed via that console. I'm sure that console has a way to free Lesser Lord Kusanali.

30220213.text: You know, Paimon's been thinking... What kind of technology could let the sages imprison even a god?

30220214.text: That isn't something they could've accomplished with their scholarly talents alone. In the Sanctuary of Surasthana, there's a device of Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's that she once used to isolate herself while meditating.

30220215.text: Five hundred years ago, the Grand Sage at the time modified the device so that it can no longer be controlled from the inside. They're effectively trapping one god with the power of another.

30220216.text: So, uh, how are we gonna get to the Grand Sage's office?

30220217.text: Don't forget, today is Jnagarbha Day, arguably the most important day to the Akademiya.

30220218.text: The sages and core Akademiya personnel are busy loading the latest batch of research developments and legal decrees into Knowledge Capsules, so that they can be entered into the Akasha.

30220219.text: All the Darshans' researchers have their noses to the grindstone, and the Akademiya's grounds are flowing with all sorts of people. It's the perfect time for an infiltration.

30220220.text: When the Grand Sage leaves his office to supervise the entering process, that's our cue to access the console and free the Dendro Archon.

subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the Akademiya together with Alhaitham

30220302.text: Please wait. Are you Scribe Alhaitham?

30220305.text: That's me. Is something the matter? I'm in a hurry.

30220306.text: Ah, n—no, I was just surprised to see you here. I had heard that the sages were looking for you not long ago, but I didn't know what for.

30220307.text: And, um, also... Please don't bring outside guests into the Akademiya.

30220310.text: Outside guests? How did you arrive at such a conclusion? Your groundless inference shames the Haravatat Darshan.

30220311.text: Wh—What did you say...? I'm the top student in Haravatat, and I earned third place at the last inter-Darshan debate. Don't look down on me!

30220312.text: That wasn't my intention. As your Haravatat senior, I just assumed that you possessed a greater aptitude for critical thinking.

30220313.text: Look. Based on what you already know, the purpose of my return and the reason they're here should be obvious.

30220314.text: I—Is that so... Wait a moment — let me think. Don't tell me the answer!

30220315.text: #The sages' search for you... A {F#blonde}{M#blond}-haired traveler... Outside guests...

30220316.text: So, from the start... the sages weren't looking for you, but this traveler? And you were gone from the Akademiya for so long because...

30220317.text: Hey, shh... Yes, you've proven yourself as the top student in Haravatat. I surmise you have arrived at the correct conclusion.

30220318.text: As I expected! Please forgive me, I wasn't thinking clearly just now. Thank you for getting me back on track.

30220319.text: It's nothing. We'll be on our way, then.

30220320.text: Alright. Thank you for your contributions to the Akademiya, Scribe.

30220321.text: What the heck just happened now...? What did he just guess?

30220322.text: I'm afraid I don't know either.

30220324.text: Mhm. He convinced himself of whatever truth he came up with.

30220325.text: That is the so-called "pride" of a scholar. If someone questions their academic facility, they will instantly feign understanding to keep up appearances.

30220326.text: Nowadays, the Akademiya is rampant with this type of scholar. Their obvious farces of intellect only serve to highlight themselves as fools.

30220327.text: Wow, so there are special ways to deal with smart people. We don't even need to make up our own excuses...

30220328.text: We shouldn't waste any more time. It would be problematic if we missed our window of opportunity. Let's go.

30220502.text: Indeed. Known as the House of Daena, it is quite possibly the most extensive special collections library in Teyvat.

30220503.text: Uh, there are a lot of students going through here... Is it really okay just to waltz right in?

30220504.text: The Akademiya marches to a fast beat, especially since it's Jnagarbha Day. They're all occupied with their own matters.

30220505.text: Just act natural. Now, hurry along.

subQuests.subQuestName: Hide for now and wait for an opportunity

30220602.text: It's a lift that Akademiya personnel use to access higher floors.

30220603.text: Are we gonna take it, then? The Grand Sage's office is up there somewhere.

30220604.text: No, not right now. We can't guarantee that we won't run into the Grand Sage. Let's step back and observe for now.

30220605.text: You think the Grand Sage will exit from there?

30220606.text: And after he does, we'd sneak past him...? Paimon thinks that's really dangerous...

30220607.text: Who knows. However, if we can confirm Azar's current location, our operation will be much safer if we...

30220608.text: ...Allow me to offer you a hint. If you wish to know his location, look behind you.

30220611.text: Aah, y—you're... What's Grand Sage Azar doing here!?

30220613.text: Do not tell me you believed the Akademiya would not grow suspicious of you after such a prolonged absence... Scribe.

30220614.text: An eyewitness had informed me of your whereabouts, so I came to personally welcome you.

30220615.text: Grand Sage, I didn't expect you to care so much about me. I'm truly flattered.

30220616.text: I'm sure, but compared to you, I am far more interested in these two unexpected guests. You are... the Traveler and Paimon, correct?

30220617.text: It's a pity that only now have I been afforded the opportunity to formally meet two of Sumeru's most esteemed guests. I do apologize for my lack of decorum.

30223301.text: Always remember that your safety comes first. Don't forget that you're the star of Zubayr Theater.

30220801.text: Aargh, don't lock us up! Let us out!

30220805.text: Oh yeah, hehe... Paimon got a bit carried away there. How was Paimon's acting just now? Great, huh?

subQuests.subQuestName: Find a way to connect to Nahida's consciousness

30223101.text: ...You think we'll get yelled at again if we play here?

30223102.text: Psh, there's nothing to be scared about. If we can shake Mr. Zubayr, the people at the Akademiya will be a piece of cake.

30223103.text: But that grandpa with the blue hat and long beard looks really scary... You think he'll be here today?

30223201.text: ...I thought you'd be interested in the Jnagarbha Day ceremony, but you're just out here instead.

30223202.text: Resting when everyone else is busy makes this moment even more idyllic. *sigh* You still have so much to learn when it comes to romance!

30223203.text: Uh... Okay, as long as you're happy.

30221001.text: Eh, is this the right spot? Are you getting anything?

30221006.text: (Nahida's not moving. She really has sealed off her consciousness... I need to think of a way to wake her up.)

30221007.text: (What is this...? It looks like... some sort of barrier?)

30221008.text: (Is Nahida using this barrier to isolate her consciousness from the outside world?)

30221012.text: (Dang it, she isn't reacting. Seems like she can't sense me...)

30221017.text: ...Oh, right. It started from the moment I was born.

30221018.text: I want to become a worthy archon.

30221101.text: Nilou, are you sure about this? You're taking such a great risk for them...

30221102.text: I'm sure, and I'm going. You know that I don't like to pass up any opportunity to dance, and this one is especially important.

30221103.text: *sigh* Alright. You seem to have a lot of trust in them, so I won't say more on the subject.

30221104.text: But if anything happens, the few of us here may not be able to help you.

30221105.text: Don't worry, they've been through worse. Everything's going to be fine!

30221106.text: Alright. You know... if you really do get arrested, we'll do everything we can to get you back. Be careful, even if it's only for our sakes.

30221107.text: Hehe, thanks, Mr. Zubayr. You're so very kind.

30221202.text: Definitely more than usual, but it's because I'm worried I won't dance well enough.

30221203.text: It's okay, just focus on your performance. We'll take care of everything else.

30221204.text: Heh, you sure know how to talk. Taking all the credit, even though we came here together to help out.

30221205.text: Well, thank you both! I'll have to treat you to a meal after all this ends. I really, really appreciate all of your help.

30221206.text: Ooh, that sounds great! How can we say no to that?

30221207.text: Alright, let's get back to business. Nilou, we'll be here to keep people from going to the Akademiya, so they don't interrupt your performance.

30221208.text: I was planning on telling them something like, "The Akademiya's been conducting a weird experiment, and some of their test subjects escaped. It's really dangerous there, so stay away!"

30221209.text: Ugh, you couldn't think of anything better? *sigh* Oh well, I guess it does sound like something the Akademiya would do.

30221210.text: Hehe, I think it sounds great. I'm counting on you guys!

30221211.text: Don't worry, it'll be a piece of cake!

30221301.text: Hey, Nilou. Sorry, it's great to see you, but I'm really busy right now. Our "Bait People Away with Yalda Candies" plan is working beautifully.

30221302.text: Do you want some candy? We have more than we can give out.

30221303.text: Vihar, thank you so much for doing all of this, and even dressed up as the Knight of Flowers, no less.

30221304.text: I'll pass on the candy, though. I cut back on sweets in the period leading up to a performance, and I'm about to start one!

30221305.text: Haha, you have a point. The "stage" is cleared and everything's ready, so you can start your performance at any time.

30221306.text: Yeah, thanks to you. I'm really grateful. Alright, time to hit the "stage"!

30221307.text: You're welcome. The honor's all mine, since I'll have such a great view of the show.

30223601.text: (Someone has knocked these two guards out and removed their Akasha Terminals not long ago. No one seems to have noticed them yet.)

30223602.text: (If they were escorting someone before being knocked out, that person must've escaped.)

30221501.text: #Ehhh, did you hear that, {NICKNAME}? It sounds like a lot of guards just ran by.

30221502.text: Does this mean the plan has moved onto the next stage?

30221505.text: Yep yep! It's great that everything seems to be going well.

30221506.text: Come to think of it, when did Alhaitham replace the Knowledge Capsule that was about to be entered into the Akasha?

subQuests.subQuestName: Interlude: Conversation Between Dehya and Rahman
Interlude: Conversation Between Dehya and Rahman

30221601.text: Here they come. Did you see that, Rahman? They came out from the Akademiya in droves!

30221603.text: After laying low in the city for so long, this is the moment we've been waiting for. My brothers have already sprung into action.

30221604.text: Heh, we couldn't do anything to 'em inside their coop, but outside the Akademiya... This is our hunting ground.

30221605.text: With a lioness like you, the prey sure won't be able to run far, haha.

30221606.text: We still need to eliminate the guards as soon as possible. If we give the sages enough time to realize what's happening, the plan's doomed.

30221607.text: Eh, all they've done is to sit on their cushy salaries and twiddle their thumbs all day while we fought and struggled every day in the desert. The only advantage they might have is their numbers.

30221608.text: Speaking of which, most of the guards who report directly to the six sages belong to the Corps of Thirty, but they have a completely different reputation.

30221609.text: Following those blasted sages' every whim, throwing away all the principles of being a mercenary... As someone in the same profession, I'm obligated to teach them a good lesson today.

30221610.text: Indeed. The "trap" has been set. All we need to do is lead them there.

30221611.text: Alright, let's each take a road and herd those scattered guards back into one place. Make sure to attract their attention. Isak will be the key.

30221612.text: You gave such an important task to that child... Will he be okay?

30221613.text: It'll be fine. Isak was so determined to help, so let's put our faith in him.

30221614.text: Besides, even if he's caught, the guards would be too scared to do anything to him... They've never seen Lesser Lord Kusanali in person, after all.

30221615.text: You've got a point. Anyway, I think I see them coming. Let's head out.

subQuests.subQuestName: Lure the Akademiya guards into the trap

30221702.text: Hey, do you remember what you need to do, Isak? When the guards get here, you'll pretend to be Lesser Lord Kusanali and run away from them.

30221703.text: Oh yeah... I remember, of course I do. I'm just a little nervous...

30221704.text: Relax. Don't think about getting caught. Even if that happens, we won't leave you behind.

30221705.text: You only need to think about getting the guards' attention and leading them to the Grand Bazaar. Leave the rest to us.

30221706.text: Okay, got it. I'm here to pay back Lesser Lord Kusanali for helping Grandpa. I won't get cold feet!

30221707.text: Hey, they're here! I can see the Akademiya guards!

30221708.text: All right! It's time, Isak. Take a deep breath... and go! You can do this!

30221709.text: (Why is there a guard over there? Did he already run ahead of me?)

30221710.text: (This is different from our plan, but there's no time. I need to make a choice...)

30221713.text: Huh? Did I... just see something dart by?

30221714.text: I'd better go have a look...

30221715.text: Were my eyes playing tricks on me...?

30221717.text: I should go check to see if someone's hiding over there.

30221719.text: Hey! Stop, I saw you! Don't try to run!

30221720.text: Isak is caught by a guard. Mission failed...

30221721.text: There seems to be nothing here. Just to be safe, I should look around.

30221723.text: Hey! Stop, I saw you! Don't try to run!

30221724.text: Isak is caught by a guard. Mission failed...

30221725.text: (Good thing they didn't find me. That was close... I'd better hurry and keep going.)

30221726.text: Hey! Lesser Lord Kusanali is over there. Stop!

30221727.text: What, Lesser Lord Kusanali? How did I not see anything just now!

30221728.text: (Oh no, they found me! Where should I go?)

30221732.text: Although Isak managed to avoid arrest, the mission failed...

30221733.text: The target, suspected to be Lesser Lord Kusanali, has escaped into the Grand Bazaar. Assemble and arrest her!

30221734.text: (How is this possible? There are also Akademiya guards here... Oh no...)

30221735.text: Isak is caught by the guards. Mission failed...

30221736.text: Hmm... Let's have a look behind the house...

30221739.text: Hey! Stop, I saw you! Don't try to run!

30221740.text: Isak is caught by a guard. Mission failed...

30221741.text: Hmm, looks like nothing's here. What a waste of time.

30221742.text: (Luckily he didn't check behind the tree. What should I do next?)

30221743.text: Return to the position behind the house

30221744.text: Isak is too tired and ends up falling asleep. Mission failed...

30221745.text: (The guard looks alert. What should I do next?)

30221747.text: Find a good opportunity to dash out

30221748.text: Doesn't seem like anything unusual's around here...

30221749.text: Hey! Stop, I saw you! Don't try to run!

30221750.text: Isak is caught by a guard. Mission failed...

30221751.text: (Looks like the guard finally left. I needa go.)

30221752.text: Hey! Lesser Lord Kusanali is over there. Stop!

30221753.text: What, Lesser Lord Kusanali? How did I not notice that!

30221754.text: (Ack, they found me! This is bad... Where should I go?)

30221758.text: (How is this possible? There is also an Akademiya guard here... Oh no...)

30221759.text: Isak is caught by the guards. Mission failed...

30221760.text: Although Isak managed to avoid arrest, the mission failed...

30221761.text: The target, suspected to be Lesser Lord Kusanali, has escaped into the Grand Bazaar. Assemble and arrest her!

subQuests.subQuestName: Lure the Akademiya guards into the trap

30222401.text: ...Where did she go? How did she disappear? Did we lose her? Hurry up and find her!

30222402.text: Hey... Why's your team here? Didn't we say to split up our search?

30222403.text: Hurry, hurry! Eh? This place is... Why are you all here?

30222404.text: Yeah, isn't it one heck of a coincidence? Everybody's here... What on earth is going on?

30222405.text: I suppose that's all of you?

30222406.text: Who are you!? Did you set us up...? What are you planning?

30222407.text: *pant* Whew, that was rough. I almost got caught!

30222408.text: Little brat... So you're not actually Lesser Lord Kusanali? Who exactly are you all? Eremites from the desert?

30222409.text: Just some colleagues. Think of this as a business competition or a personal grudge...

30222410.text: After stepping into our trap, stop thinking of yourselves as "hunters." Behave like the "prey" you are.

30222412.text: An ambush! How's that possible? This is Sumeru City, but mercenaries from the desert somehow ambushed us!?

30222413.text: Tsk, you've spent all your time hiding away in the Akademiya. This place has long since become our hunting ground. Brace yourselves!

30221902.text: The Akademiya has quieted down after the conclusion of the Jnagarbha Day ceremonies, but it's much quieter than usual.

30221903.text: Where are the guards? Why have I not seen a single one...? Guards? Guards!

30221904.text: Grand Sage, how may I be of assistance?

30221905.text: I called for the guards. Why did you come?

30221907.text: Right now, all Akademiya guards have entered the city to perform the ordered arrest. I thought you knew...

30221908.text: Arrest? Who is there to arrest...?

30221910.text: A—Arrest Lesser Lord Kusanali, right? Is that not what the order was?

30221911.text: Lesser Lord Kusanali? You mean she has disappeared?

30221912.text: Ah, yes. I wouldn't dare make up something like that...

30221913.text: Right now, everyone is in a panic, and many are saying that... that Lesser Lord Kusanali will take revenge on us...

30221914.text: (What happened? Just what is going on?)

30221915.text: (Lesser Lord Kusanali somehow escaped? Was it Alhaitham and his party that freed her?)

30221916.text: (That's impossible... The Akademiya is heavily guarded today, and any order to release Lesser Lord Kusanali would be strictly confidential. Besides, Alhaitham and the Traveler are already in our hands...)

30221917.text: (What manner of trickery did they employ? How could Lesser Lord Kusanali disappear into thin air...?)

30221919.text: How was the arrest order distributed to the guards?

30221920.text: It was issued by the Akasha earlier today. Only you have the authority to send messages like that, so I thought it was your order...

30221923.text: "Lesser Lord Kusanali has escaped from the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Go to the city and arrest the escapee immediately..."

30221924.text: (The Akasha indeed contains this information, and it clearly appeared in my mind.)

30221925.text: (...How did they bypass my permissions to issue this kind of message?)

30221926.text: (Was it the report about the Traveler that Alhaitham submitted?)

30221927.text: (No, I specifically checked that Knowledge Capsule before entering it into the Akasha... Could that have been... a red herring?)

30221928.text: (Well, even if I figure it out now, it won't make any difference. The important thing now is to confirm Lesser Lord Kusanali's status...)

30221929.text: Have you been to the Sanctuary of Surasthana to confirm that Lesser Lord Kusanali has indeed escaped?

30221931.text: I—It may be a bit offensive to say this, but... Grand Sage, what you're saying doesn't make any sense...

30221932.text: How can the information in the Akasha be inaccurate...? What the Akasha decrees is fact — that is common knowledge to all of us...

30221933.text: If we have to confirm the information and knowledge from the Akasha ourselves...

30221934.text: Then how is that any different from us learning that information ourselves? Wouldn't Greater Lord Rukkhadevata's legacy lose its meaning that way...?

30221935.text: In the beginning, it was I who asked you to believe in the Akasha, to believe in the legacy left by Greater Lord Rukkhadevata... Are you trying to use my words against me?

30221936.text: N—No! Grand Sage, I'm merely confused because I believe in you. I never meant to refute you...

30221937.text: Hmph... Stay here and see if there are any suspicious people around... I'll go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana on my own.

subQuests.subQuestName: Interlude: Grand Sage Azar Arriving at the Sanctuary of Surasthana
Interlude: Grand Sage Azar Arriving at the Sanctuary of Surasthana

30222001.text: Grand Sage Azar arrives at the Sanctuary of Surasthana alone...

30222002.text: ("Lesser Lord Kusanali has escaped from the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Go to the city and arrest the escapee immediately...")

30222003.text: (How can that be...? Stop thinking about it, stop... It must be a trick of theirs. As long as I personally confirm it...)

30222005.text: ...Impossible. That's impossible. There must be something wrong with my eyes...

30222007.text: Eh? She really appeared again... What is the meaning of this...?

30222010.text: Once the Akasha has put certain thoughts into your head, even the Grand Sage can no longer see what's right in front of him.

30222011.text: You all can only see the world in your mind, the one you think you know.

30222012.text: And precisely because of this, you disregarded Lesser Lord Kusanali's existence...

30222013.text: She has been a wise and worthy archon.

30222014.text: Cyno... Have you been waiting for a chance like this?

30222015.text: The Akasha predicted that you would return to the Akademiya to confront me, but I didn't expect it to turn out like this. I was careless.

30222016.text: No, you were blinded. Your faults stem from your reliance on the Akasha. You're still the same as always.

30222017.text: I truly did not expect a proud person like you to cooperate with Alhaitham and the Traveler...

30222018.text: People change, Azar. Admit it, the Akasha can't predict my actions anymore.

30222019.text: Hmph, then tell me, what have you found during your investigation?

30222020.text: You want to buy time? This is the Sanctuary of Surasthana. Under your own regulations, even Akademiya staff are forbidden to come here... No one will come to save you.

30222021.text: As for the investigation... I've at least confirmed that you are guilty of insurgency against the archon, a serious crime.

30222022.text: So what? Did you do all of this so I would plead guilty in front of you, General Mahamatra?

30222023.text: No. I want you to plead guilty in front of the archon herself.

30222024.text: You once said that I had no standing to judge you. So now, how about judgment in the name of a god?

30222101.text: Hmm... How long do we have to wait? Paimon wants to know how things are going out there!

30222102.text: Paimon hasn't heard any sounds outside for a while. Hopefully something bad didn't happen...

30222105.text: Yeah, but aren't you scared that we might be locked up in here for the rest of our lives?

30222106.text: Thinking about it, at least Paimon has you. We can still chat like this...

30222107.text: When Paimon thinks of Nahida being imprisoned alone in the Sanctuary of Surasthana, Paimon can't help but feel sorry for her...

30222109.text: Dehya! Hehe, Paimon just knew you would come to rescue us!

30222110.text: You were scared out of your wits just a moment ago...

30222111.text: You two really owe me some big thanks. I had to search through who knows how many guards to find the key here... It felt even more tiring than whacking 'em! I'm exhausted.

30222112.text: Thanks a lot. Need Paimon to rub your shoulders?

30222113.text: Uh... No, no, that's... Er, I'll pass.

30222114.text: What are you afraid of? Oh, are you ticklish?

30222115.text: Ugh, now isn't the time to talk about being ticklish...

30223401.text: You really like to play cool in front of Nilou.

30223402.text: Hey, cut it out... This isn't the time to chat about stuff like that.

subQuests.subQuestName: Go to the Sanctuary of Surasthana

30222302.text: Should I say "It's nice to meet you"?

30222303.text: This is the first time we've met in real life. Before, we've only met in dreams, consciousness, or when I was in someone else's body.

30222305.text: Thank you so much for coming to rescue me, but I also need to apologize...

30222306.text: During this time, I did some self-reflection. My sense of inferiority and yielding to the Akademiya led to all of this, and created so much trouble for you all.

30222309.text: Exactly! We're here because you're a good archon and one of our friends.

30222311.text: Whew... Amazing, so this is how it feels to walk out of that cage with my own body.

30222312.text: It's like I just had an endlessly long dream... I can't even tell if I just woke up or was only now born into this world.

30222313.text: My concept of "self" has become so clear...

30222314.text: But now doesn't seem to be the time to indulge in this feeling.

30229903.text: There's a light flashing on your Akasha Terminal. It's almost like... the faster it blinks, the better the signal.

30229904.text: Whoa, it's Mora! Ooh, Mora... No Paimon, we're not here to hunt for treasure!

30229906.text: This isn't the way to the Akademiya. Better stick to the plan.

30229907.text: #We might as well prepare for a fight, {NICKNAME}.

30229908.text: When we're done, we can take a walk around. After all, we missed out on a lot of stuff when we were locked up.

30229909.text: ...Oh, right. It started from the moment I was born.\n

30229910.text: I want to become a worthy archon.

30229912.text: Kept listening to my people and their hearts...\n

30229913.text: Kept looking for a way to save Irminsul...

30229915.text: Catch up to Greater Lord Rukkhadevata.

30229916.text: But, I'm stuck in the Sanctuary of Surasthana...\n

30229917.text: The sages are creating a god to replace me...\n

30229918.text: And I'm forced to lock my consciousness in this boundless darkness.

30229920.text: Now that I think of it, I don't think I've ever actually listened to my own inner voice...

30229923.text: Have I been... doing the right thing?\n

30229925.text: How do I... really feel about all of this?

30229928.text: Since you're the God of Wisdom...

30229929.text: You've known the answers to all these questions since the very beginning, haven't you?

30229930.text: Who... are you? Whose voice is that? It sounds familiar...

30229933.text: I won't... I won't ignore my own voice anymore.

30285101.text: Hey, it's you guys! How did your plan go? Are you here for Nilou?

30285102.text: It went really well! And yeah, where's Nilou?

30285103.text: Great to hear! Nilou's already returned to the Grand Bazaar. Just now, a crowd of Akademiya students came by to ask Nilou for her signature. I've never seen her run away so fast!
